faultModel: After own actual ACK1, a separately signed real peer CAS advances the server. Own member2 submits ONLY its own ACK1 tuple and receives actual409; member3 never sends. A separate case holds real ACK1 while a later native Tags commit invalidates the original receipt.
preservedAssertions: Three prepared effects and every original create/archive/shared-registration/label-import/delete local mutation remain.
First own attempt genuinely commits, second genuinely fails, and no third own attempt occurs.
Every original pending/completed flag and complete committed native image survive.
Native interleave commits while the first actual ACK remains outstanding; exact first/old/remaining label effects are checked.
Actual BHR builder and queue worker update a shared native registration list into both existing vaults; both decoded arrays and pending false are retained.
strongerObservables: Real competing peer commit is independently distinguished from own requests; its remote-only recovery record survives.
Own member2 cannot borrow peer tuple or retry/rebase; full original ACK chain is checked.
Actual full signed snapshots prove exact committed/remaining remote content.
Explicit old receipt replay sends zero further HTTP.
Shared-registration happy path verifies the entire local/remote image and current proof before an explicit consumed-receipt replay.
